subject: Re: Confirmed booking BK-5NVFGRA6: MUC-DXB schedule and acceptance cutoff | 29 Nov | Sonnberg
body:
Dear Alex,

We acknowledge your confirmed booking. We cannot verify the Munich cargo acceptance cutoff or the scheduled Dubai arrival date and time from the information available. The transit time of 1 day does not establish either of these local times.

Our fixed price is 1395.36 EUR, valid until 22 Nov 2026 05:11 UTC. The reference to quote when booking is R-UG0__DICZeMxi4BL.

Kind regards,
Lumen Air Cargo

classification.reasoning: The airline replies to a request for the booking’s acceptance cutoff and arrival time but cannot provide those details.
